Klasse Util

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Util
public final class Util extends Object

A small collection of general-purpose helper methods focused on input validation and defensive programming in a functional style.

This class only contains static methods and cannot be instantiated.

  • Methodendetails

    • requireNonEmpty

      public static <C extends Collection<A>, A, E extends Exception> C requireNonEmpty(@NonNull C collection, @NonNull Supplier<E> exceptionSupplier) throws E

      Requires that the given collection is not empty.

      Returns the same collection instance if it is not empty; otherwise throws the exception supplied by exceptionSupplier.

      Contract: exceptionSupplier.get() must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      C - the concrete collection type
      A - the element type
      E - the exception type to be thrown
      Parameter:
      collection - the collection to check; must not be null
      exceptionSupplier - supplies the exception to throw when the collection is empty; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the same collection instance (for fluent usage)
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if collection or exceptionSupplier is null, or if exceptionSupplier.get() returns null
      E - if collection is empty
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • requireNonNullElements

      public static <A, C extends Collection<A>, E extends Exception> C requireNonNullElements(@NonNull C collection, @NonNull Fun<Integer,E> exceptionConstructor) throws E

      Requires that all elements in the given collection are non-null.

      Returns the same collection instance if all elements are non-null; otherwise throws an exception created by exceptionConstructor.

      Contract: exceptionConstructor.apply(index) must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      A - element type
      C - concrete collection type
      E - the exception type to be thrown
      Parameter:
      collection - the collection to check; must not be null
      exceptionConstructor - builds the exception to throw; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the same collection instance (for fluent usage)
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null or the constructor returns null
      E - if a null element is found
      Seit:

    • requireNonNullResult1

      public static <X, Y, E extends RuntimeException> Fun<X,Y> requireNonNullResult1(@NonNull Function<X,Y> function, @NonNull Fun<X,E> exceptionConstructor) throws E

      Wraps a unary function and enforces a non-null result.

      The returned Fun throws a NullPointerException if its input argument is null, and an exception created by exceptionConstructor if the wrapped function returns null.

      Contract: exceptionConstructor.apply(x) must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      X - input type
      Y - result type
      E - exception type
      Parameter:
      function - function to wrap; must not be null
      exceptionConstructor - builds the exception to throw; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Fun that rejects null arguments and null results
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if function or exceptionConstructor is null
      E
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • requireNonNullResult2

      public static <X1, X2, Y, E extends RuntimeException> Fun2<X1,X2,Y> requireNonNullResult2(@NonNull BiFunction<X1,X2,Y> function, @NonNull Fun2<X1,X2,E> exceptionConstructor) throws E

      Wraps a binary function and enforces a non-null result.

      The returned Fun2 throws a NullPointerException if any of its input arguments is null, and an exception created by exceptionConstructor if the wrapped function returns null.

      Contract: exceptionConstructor.apply(x1, x2) must not return null.

    • isSubSet

      public static <A> boolean isSubSet(@NonNull Set<A> superSet, @NonNull Set<A> subSet)

      Checks whether subSet is a subset of superSet.

      A subset means every element of subSet is contained in superSet.

      Typparameter:
      A - element type
      Parameter:
      superSet - the superset; must not be null
      subSet - the subset candidate; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      true if subSet is a subset of superSet; otherwise false
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if superSet or subSet is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • isProperSubSet

      public static <A> boolean isProperSubSet(@NonNull Set<A> superSet, @NonNull Set<A> subSet)

      Checks if a set is a proper subset of another set.

      A proper subset of a set superSet is a set subSet that is a subset of superSet and is not equal to superSet. Mathematically: subSet ⊂ superSet.

      Typparameter:
      A - the type of elements in the sets
      Parameter:
      superSet - the superset to check against; must not be null
      subSet - the potential proper subset; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      true if subSet is a proper subset of superSet; false otherwise
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if superSet or subSet is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0
      Siehe auch:
      • isSubSet(Set, Set)

    • requireConcrete

      public static <A, E extends RuntimeException> Class<A> requireConcrete(@NonNull Class<A> clazz, @NonNull Supplier<E> exceptionSupplier) throws E

      Requires that the given class represents a concrete (instantiable) class.

      A concrete class is neither an interface nor abstract, nor a primitive or annotation type. Returns the same class object if it is concrete; otherwise throws the exception supplied by exceptionSupplier.

      Contract: exceptionSupplier.get() must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      A - class type
      E - exception type
      Parameter:
      clazz - class to check; must not be null

      Gibt zurück:
      the same Class instance
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if clazz or exceptionSupplier is null, or if exceptionSupplier.get() returns null
      E - if clazz is an interface, primitive, annotation, or abstract

      public static String toSafeFileName(@NonNull String name)

      Converts a string into a safe file name.

      Replaces all whitespaces with underscores and removes all characters that are not alphanumeric, dots, hyphens, or underscores.

      Gibt zurück:
      a safe file name string
